evidence.sourceTitle: REBOOT26 (Verified LeRobot Tasks) official release documentation
evidence.locator: Official dataset registry; three named releases: meta/info.json
evidence.statement: The official registry links named LeRobot task releases. Their actual meta/info.json files define action, observation.state, camera/depth videos, timestamp and frame/episode indices. The three inspected manifests report 60, 62 and 60 episodes respectively; schema inspection replaces the previous profile-only evidence.
